correct.zh: 正确答案是「イ 报告_10092 情报太郎」。表1 规定的文件名格式是 “报告_” ＋ yymm ＋ w ＋ 编制者姓名，只要按照标记规则逐项套用即可。首先根据标记规则①，被 “ ” 括起来的字符原样用于文件名，所以开头是 报告_。接着根据②，yymm 是所报告的年月，年取公历年份的后 2 位，y 和 m 的个数分别表示各自的位数，因此 2010 年 9 月就是 yy＝10、mm＝09，即 4 位的 1009。月份不写成 9 而要补 0 写成 09，这是最大的要点。再根据②的后半部分，w 是每个月内周的连续编号，格式中 w 只有 1 个，所以是 1 位；因为是第 2 周，所以 w＝2。编制者姓名原样写作 情报太郎。最后根据③，＋ 是把前后字符连接起来的符号，不包含在文件名中，因此全部连接起来得到 报告_10092情报太郎，与选项 イ 一致。另外，选项中数字与姓名之间看起来的空格是原书排版上的间隔，表1 的格式定义并未规定空格，按规则二者是连在一起的。
correct.en: The correct answer is 「イ Hokoku_10092 JohoTaro」. The file name format defined in Table 1 is “Hokoku_” ＋ yymm ＋ w ＋ author name, and you only need to apply the notation rules one item at a time. First, by notation rule ①, characters enclosed in “ ” are used in the file name just as they are, so it starts with Hokoku_. Next, by rule ②, yymm is the year and month being reported, the year uses the last 2 digits of the Western calendar year, and the number of y and m shows how many digits each takes; therefore September 2010 becomes yy＝10 and mm＝09, that is the 4 digits 1009. The biggest point is that the month is written as 09 with a leading zero, not as 9. Then, by the latter half of rule ②, w is the serial number of the week within each month, and since the format contains only one w it is 1 digit; because it is the 2nd week, w＝2. The author name is written as it is: JohoTaro. Finally, by rule ③, ＋ is a symbol that joins the characters before and after it and is not included in the file name, so joining everything gives Hokoku_10092JohoTaro, which matches choice イ. Note that the space that appears between the digits and the name in the choices is a typesetting gap in the original booklet; the format definition in Table 1 specifies no space, so by the rule they are joined together.

distractors.zh: 报告_100902 情报太郎 的数字部分有 6 位。到 yymm＝1009 为止都正确，但错在把后面的 w 写成了 2 位的 02。表1 的②规定「w 是所报告的月内周的连续编号，y、m、w 的个数分别表示各自的位数」，格式中的 w 只有 1 个，所以第 2 周必须写成 1 位的 2。这是受月份 09 的影响、把周也补零写成 2 位的典型错误答案。
distractors.en: In Hokoku_100902 JohoTaro the numeric part has 6 digits. It is correct up to yymm＝1009, but the mistake is writing the following w as 02 in 2 digits. Rule ② of Table 1 states that 「w is the serial number of the week within the month being reported, and the number of y, m, and w shows how many digits each takes」, and since the format contains only one w, the 2nd week must be written as the single digit 2. This is a typical wrong answer in which the 09 of the month leads you to zero-pad the week to 2 digits as well.

distractors.zh: 报告_10902 情报太郎 的数字部分是 10902，形式上是在年 10 之后把月写成 1 位的 9、把周写成 2 位的 02。按表1 的②，mm 有 2 个，所以月份必须是 2 位的 09；w 只有 1 个，所以周是 1 位的 2。它与正确答案 10092 只是 0 的位置对调，不留意位数规则地一眼扫过很难分辨。应当按照「位数由格式中字符的个数决定」这一原则机械地判断。
distractors.en: In Hokoku_10902 JohoTaro the numeric part is 10902, a form in which, after the year 10, the month is written as the single digit 9 and the week as the 2 digits 02. By rule ② of Table 1 there are two m, so the month must be the 2 digits 09, and there is only one w, so the week is the single digit 2. Since only the position of the 0 is swapped compared with the correct 10092, it is hard to tell apart if you just glance at it without keeping the digit rule in mind. You should judge mechanically by the principle that the number of digits is decided by the number of characters in the format.

distractors.zh: 报告_1092 情报太郎 的数字部分只有 4 位。这是因为把年 10、月 9、周 2 排在一起时，月份仍然写成了 1 位。根据表1 的②，月份用 mm 的 2 位表示，所以应写成 09，数字部分必须是 yymm＋w 合计 5 位（10092）。另外还要记住，统一文件名位数的目的在于按名称排序时年、月、周的顺序能正确排列，省略补零就会破坏这一目的。
distractors.en: In Hokoku_1092 JohoTaro the numeric part has only 4 digits. This is because the year 10, the month 9, and the week 2 were lined up with the month left as a single digit. By rule ② of Table 1 the month is expressed with the 2 digits of mm, so it should be 09, and the numeric part must be the total of 5 digits of yymm＋w (10092). It is also worth remembering that the purpose of keeping the number of digits in file names uniform is that sorting by name lines up years, months, and weeks in the correct order, and omitting the zero padding breaks that purpose.

points.zh: 文件命名规则的套用：格式中符号的个数表示位数（yymm 是年 2 位＋月 2 位共 4 位，w 是 1 位）。年取公历年份的后 2 位，1 位数的月份补 0 写成 09 是惯例；位数统一之后，按文件名排序的结果就与按日期排序一致。
points.en: Applying file naming rules: the number of symbols in the format shows the number of digits (yymm is 2 digits of year ＋ 2 digits of month, 4 in total; w is 1 digit). The year uses the last 2 digits of the Western calendar year, and zero-padding a single-digit month to 09 is the standard practice; once the number of digits is uniform, sorting by file name matches sorting by date.

points.zh: 标记规则中符号的读法：被 “ ” 括起来的字符串（“报告_”）作为字面量原样用于文件名，而 ＋ 是连接前后部分的连接符号，不出现在实际的文件名中。要避免把规格中写出的符号照字面输出的错误。
points.en: How to read the symbols in the notation rules: a string enclosed in “ ” (“Hokoku_”) is used literally in the file name as it is, while ＋ is a concatenation symbol joining what comes before and after it and does not appear in the actual file name. Avoid the mistake of outputting the symbols written in the specification literally.
